meta.title: Bulk counter offer on a Global Field

plan.title: Bulk counter offer on global field

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ responses screen containing several vendor bids.
Open the bulk counter-offer drawer from the RFQ Settings menu.

args.goal: select a global field, enter the new counter value, click Send Counter Offer, and verify the screen shows the global field changed from its original value to the counter value and shows Counter Offer Requested above every vendor name

steps.note: Perform and observe the global-field bulk counter-offer flow, including the submission result and per-vendor counter-offer indicators.
Verify the application reports successful submission.
Verify the counter-offer status is visible on the vendor comparison screen.
